summary: Coupang, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that on June 10, 2026, the Korean Personal Information Protection Commission announced administrative fines totaling approximately $410 million against its subsidiary Coupang Corp.: ~$278 million for a November 2025 data incident and ~$132 million for alleged violations in collecting/storing third-party advertising data. The fines will be recognized in Q2 2026 operating expenses. Coupang Corp. plans to vigorously pursue judicial relief in the Seoul Administrative Court; payments are not automatically stayed during appeal. No deal terms apply.
